title: Acceptance tests assert exact facts from the full real-world CSVs instead of owned fixtures
evidence: competitions.spec.ts:11 confirmChampion({points:90}); teams.spec.ts:11 confirmRecord({matches:19}); competitions.spec.ts:16 confirmRelegated(['Chapecoense','Avaí','CSA','Cruzeiro']) all read against data/kaggle loaded at src/server.ts:10-11. A refreshed/re-versioned Kaggle export breaks them with no code regression.
suggestion: Point the driver at a small committed fixtures dir via the existing SOCCER_DATA_DIR hook (src/server.ts:10) and assert facts the suite authors; keep a separate smoke check for loading the real data.

title: Test titled 'rank teams by home record' actually requests the away ranking
evidence: competitions.spec.ts:44-46 — it('should rank teams by home record') calls soccer.stats.requestBestRecord({ venue: 'away' }). Title and behaviour disagree.
suggestion: Change venue to 'home' or retitle the test to match the away ranking it exercises.

title: Brasileirão matches de-duplicated by season+home+away can merge legitimately distinct fixtures
evidence: src/data.ts:82 keys Brasileirão rows as `${competition}|${season}|${home}|${away}` (dropping date) to avoid cross-file double counting; documented tradeoff in docs/atdd-findings.md. Any season with a replayed fixture would collapse to one row.
suggestion: If replays/annulled matches matter, include a discriminator (round/date) in the key for the non-league path; otherwise leave the documented tradeoff.

title: 15 MCP tools registered, well beyond the spec's required query categories
evidence: src/server.ts registers search_matches, last_meeting, team_record, head_to_head, team_competitions, team_profile, search_players, players_by_club, standings, libertadores_bracket, stats_overview, biggest_wins, best_records, compare_seasons — exceeding R3–R11.
suggestion: No action; surplus capability, not a deduction.
